_comment: These are hard numeric limits. Claude's reasoning/thesis step may NEVER override these values. Any proposed trade that violates a rule here must be rejected before it reaches review_equity_order, with no exceptions regardless of how strong the thesis sounds.

execution.note: mode must be manually changed from 'dry_run' to 'live' by the human. Claude must never change this value itself, and must refuse to place live orders while mode is 'dry_run'.

universe.supplementary_scan_note: Robinhood scan 'Short-term Momentum Breakout' -- $5B-$50B cap (matches universe.min_market_cap_usd/max_market_cap_usd's lower bound), price >= 5, 30d avg volume >= 1M, positive operating margin, RSI(14) 48-73, price above 200d MA and 1.0-1.05x its 20d MA (matches entry_extension), price >= 85% of 52w high, 5d change +1.5% to +18%, 5d/30d avg volume >= 1.15. Deliberately avoids same-day change/relative-volume hard filters because Phase A runs after the close, when day change reads 0. Sorted by same-day relative volume desc. Prior scan 'Cyclical Deep Value' (320b00d0-848f-4029-a358-98c6c641a01c) is kept in Robinhood if you want to switch back. Additive to watchlist_max_candidates, not shared with it -- the watchlist's own slots are never crowded out by scan results.

signal_thresholds._comment: A Step-1 candidate qualifies for a Phase A news search + thesis (i.e. counts as a 'notable signal') if it meets ANY ONE of these three, computed from data already pulled in Steps 1-2 (no extra API calls). This is a mechanical gate, not a judgment call. Currently-held positions are exempt and always get a thesis regardless of these thresholds.

position_sizing.min_top_up_note: A top-up only fires if the computed buy amount clears max($1.00 broker minimum, min_top_up_usd, min_top_up_pct_of_target x target_size for that candidate's conviction tier). Below that, skip without calling review_equity_order -- a top-up smaller than this doesn't move the position meaningfully, and letting headroom shrink toward zero every cycle otherwise generates a long tail of dust-sized orders as the position converges on target. Applies to top-ups only, never to new-entry sizing. top_ups_enabled=false (current) turns top-ups off entirely: held candidates are not sent to position_sizing.py and produce no risk_check lines (backtest showed top-ups add churn, not return). risk_per_trade_pct_of_account caps a NEW entry so that a full stop-out loses at most this share of total_value: dollar_amount = min(conviction tier target, risk_per_trade_pct_of_account x total_value / stop_pct), where stop_pct is the same volatility-scaled stop the position would carry (scripts/stop_loss.py --compute-stop-pct-only). max_new_positions_per_day / _per_week stagger entries (counts are of buys placed/would-be-placed this calendar day / this Mon-Fri week); max_positions_per_sector caps same-sector concentration (sector comes from Phase A thesis entries; a candidate without a sector skips this check and is logged as such).

stop_loss.note: mode is 'fixed' or 'volatility_scaled' -- toggle only. 'fixed' uses the flat hard_stop_pct for every symbol. 'volatility_scaled': stop_pct per symbol = clamp(volatility_stdev_multiplier * stdev of daily close-to-close returns over volatility_lookback_trading_days, min_stop_pct, max_stop_pct), recomputed fresh from get_equity_historicals each cycle; falls back to fallback_stop_pct if historicals are unavailable or the symbol has fewer than 10 daily bars. Every open position must have this stop checked on every cycle, independent of any new thesis about the stock. A good new narrative does not cancel a stop-loss.

take_profit.note: Tiered take-profit that fully exits the position. sell_fraction_of_position is a share of the quantity REMAINING when the tier fires (not of the original quantity), so 0.3333 -> 0.5 -> 1.0 sells one third of the original position at each tier and leaves nothing after the third. Tiers were lowered from 15/30/50% because holding periods run 1-2 weeks and no position ever reached +15% (max seen +7%); a backtest on the live entries gave the lower tiers a small edge. Every open position must have this checked on every cycle, independent of any new thesis about the stock -- this account is short-term oriented, not buy-and-hold. A good new narrative does not cancel a take-profit tier any more than it cancels a stop-loss. Each tier fires once (per holding period, i.e. since the position last closed to zero) when gain first reaches it -- see PHASE_B_TASK.md Step 5 for the exact mechanics. After the first tier fires the stop reference switches to the trailing high (see stop_loss.py). See sell_reentry_lock for re-entry lock behavior.

conviction_trim.note: DISABLED (enabled=false): the trims were tiny, near break-even and fed the wash-sale/re-entry locks without measurable benefit. Trims a held position to its conviction-tier target once conviction has been 'low' or 'medium' (i.e. not 'high') for min_overweight_conviction_cycles consecutive cycles and the overage exceeds overweight_trigger_pct -- see scripts/conviction_trim.py. See sell_reentry_lock for re-entry lock behavior.

sell_reentry_lock.note: Applies to every sell reason: a loss-closed sell locks re-entry until price drops below the sale price; a gain-closed sell locks until price drops below the sale price or gain_close_max_trading_days trading days pass, whichever comes first. See scripts/entry_gate.py.

loss_limits.stop_cluster_note: Circuit breaker for clustered stop-outs. If max_stops or more stop_loss triggers (distinct symbol+date) fall within the last window_trading_days trading days (today = day 0), new entries are halted until pause_trading_days trading days have passed since the most recent stop, then new-entry dollar sizes are multiplied by size_multiplier until the cluster ages out of the window. Computed by scripts/stop_cluster.py; never blocks sells.

wash_sale_avoidance.note: Toggle only -- set enabled to false to turn this guard off entirely; no other change needed. IRS wash-sale rule applies per taxpayer across ALL accounts, not per account, so this checks linked_accounts, not just account_number. Blocks BUYS only (new entries and top-ups) -- never blocks a stop_loss/take_profit/exit_existing sell, since risk management must never bend to a tax outcome; those sells are instead logged with a wash-sale flag if one applies, for the human's own tax tracking. This cannot prevent a wash sale caused by a purchase made LATER in another linked account after an agentic-account sell -- those accounts are outside this pipeline's control; only the human can avoid that side.

entry_price_gap.note: Hard ceiling on buys -- a gap this large skips the buy this cycle even if the thesis still reads fine, same principle as a stop-loss. Never applies to sells. Checked in Phase B Step 4 (price-based staleness check), before Step 5's risk enforcement -- not part of the execution.mode live-order gate.

entry_extension.note: Lowered from 0.10 to 0.05: in a backtest of the momentum scan, entries 5-10% above the 20d average averaged -1.2% per trade vs +0.4% for those within 5%. Hard ceiling on buys -- skips the buy this cycle if current_price is more than max_extension_pct above its own lookback_trading_days-day moving average, same principle as entry_price_gap. Never applies to sells.

earnings_blackout.note: Skips new entries and top-ups when the symbol's next earnings report is within blackout_trading_days trading days (0 = today), so fresh money isn't put on a binary event. Never applies to sells.

intraday_monitor.note: PHASE_C_TASK.md: script-only stop-loss / take-profit sweep run during market hours between the daily Phase B runs, so a stop is not only checked once at the open. Sells only (stop_loss and take_profit), same live-order gate as Phase B Step 6, no news search, no buys. Set enabled=false to stop it from acting. The scheduler itself lives outside this repo.

early_exit_guard.note: Within window_trading_days of a holding period's opening buy, an exit_existing sell requires a new_fact_date after the entry thesis's date -- a thesis can't reverse on facts it already had. Never blocks stop_loss/take_profit/conviction_trim.
